Setup and removal

      

        
    
          
  1. On a compatible Android 11+ phone’s initial welcome screen, tap six times to open the enrollment scanner. Scan this QR from another screen.
    2. 
          
  2. Connect to the internet, let TestDPC install, and choose “Use for work & personal.” Finish setup.
    3. 
          
  3. Open the briefcase-badged TestDPC in the Work tab. Check that it says it is a profile owner of an organization-owned device.
    4. 
          
  4. To remove management, open work-profile TestDPC → Data wipe → Remove work profile. Under Also wipe, select External storage and Factory reset protection, then press OK. Confirm the work-profile deletion notification, then uninstall remaining TestDPC.
    5. 
        

        
The selected options wipe external storage and reset-protection data. “Factory reset device” erases the phone. Choose “Remove work profile” for this procedure.
